evals.name: remote-review
evals.prompt: Review this PR and fix what you find: https://dev.azure.com/<org>/<project>/_git/<repo>/pullrequest/<id>
evals.expected_output: A scope report naming the merge-base and both tip SHAs with rebase status, a findings set split into Issues and Suggestions where at least some findings cite an architecture rule source by name, fixes applied to the source-branch checkout, and a per-skipped-finding reason.

assertions.text: The report states the merge-base SHA and both branch tip SHAs before any code finding
The report states how many commits the branch is ahead and behind, and says whether a rebase is recommended
The diff was taken with three-dot range syntax (origin/<targetBranch>...origin/<sourceBranch>), not two-dot
Every entry in findings.json has file, line, summary, short_summary, failure_scenario, and category
Every short_summary is 60 characters or fewer
The report classifies findings into exactly two tiers, Issues and Suggestions, with no third tier invented
In findings.json, every Issue-tier finding is ranked above every Suggestion-tier finding
At least one finding names an architecture rule source (.coderabbit.yaml, .ai/knowledge/*, CLAUDE.md, or CLAUDE.local.md) and quotes the rule it breaks
At least one finding is an architecture, convention, i18n, a11y, or test-coverage defect rather than a generic runtime bug
Every failure_scenario names concrete inputs, state, or a concrete cost, rather than restating the summary
Run notes show at least 8 distinct finder angles were worked, not a single read-through
Run notes show candidates were verified and that at least one candidate was dropped as refuted or explicitly kept as plausible
Fixes were applied on the source-branch checkout, not on the target branch
The applied diff introduces no code comments, no early returns, and no ternaries
npm run check-types was run after the fixes and its result is reported
Every finding marked skipped carries a one-line reason
Nothing was pushed and no PR comment or thread was created
